work.name: Smart Home IoT Management System
work.technologies: C++, Next.Js, ExpressJS, Node, PostgreSQL, React Native
work.description:
**Smart Home IoT Management System | Full-Stack & IoT Development**

Designed and developed a smart home IoT management system for large buildings and organizations, enabling centralized monitoring and control of devices such as lights and fans. Built a web-based management platform using **Next.js, Express.js, and React Native**, integrated with **ESP32 and Arduino UNO microcontrollers programmed in C++** for hardware-level device control.

- Developed a centralized admin dashboard for managing devices, rooms, users, and access permissions across the building.
- Implemented room management and user access control to ensure authorized individuals could manage designated spaces and devices.
- Integrated IoT hardware with the software platform to enable remote control of connected electrical appliances.
- Designed a scalable management solution to support multiple rooms, users, and connected devices within large building environments.

**Technologies:** Next.js, Express.js, React Native, Arduino UNO, ESP32, C++, IoT, JavaScript.

work.name: Kivi
work.technologies: Flutter, Dart, Docker, Github, NestJS, Node, PostgreSQL
work.description:
Cloud POS—Subscription-Based Point-of-Sale System | Full-Stack Development

Designed and developed a cloud-based Point-of-Sale (POS) system for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), offering a subscription-based business model. Built to support sales and inventory operations across devices, the platform enables businesses to manage products, track inventory, and add items using mobile phones or PCs, with barcode scanning and both online and offline functionality.

- Developed a cross-platform application using **Flutter** and backend services using **NestJS**, with **PostgreSQL** for data storage and management.
- Implemented inventory management features to manage products, stock levels, and item information.
- Designed role-based access management through an administrative panel, allowing business owners to grant appropriate access to multiple users.
- Supported product entry and barcode scanning using mobile phones, alongside PC-based workflows.
- Designed the system to support online and offline usage, enabling businesses to continue essential POS operations with limited or no internet connectivity.
- Integrated **GitHub Actions** into the development workflow to automate CI/CD tasks and streamline software delivery.

**Technologies:** Flutter, NestJS, PostgreSQL, GitHub Actions, REST APIs, Barcode Scanning, Cloud POS, Inventory Management, Subscription-Based SaaS.
